name: Clearout AI
description: AI-powered household inventory and listing app. Users upload photos of items, AI extracts metadata (name, category, condition, price estimate), and generates sale listings for Marketplace/eBay.
purpose: Dario's primary summer recruiting project. Full-stack engineering (frontend, backend, database, external AI API) + Product Management (user research, MVP definition, metrics tracking). Learning goal: deep understanding of every line of code and product thinking.
status: Phase 3 - July 2026. Building MVP features. Focus: clean code + product validation.
instructionsForClaude: Dario is learning full-stack engineering + product management. For EVERY code or decision: (1) Explain what/why, (2) Walk through line by line, (3) Show design tradeoffs, (4) Ask if he understands. Learning is the goal — he should understand every decision. Also think like a PM: What problem does this solve? Who wants it? How do we measure success?

techStack.database: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS)

keyArchitectureDecisions: Async job pipeline: AI processing happens in background, not on user request
Row Level Security (RLS): Each user can only see their own data at database level
Zod validation: All AI outputs and user inputs validated against schemas
Structured extraction: Gemini returns JSON that matches a schema with fallbacks

gitWorkflow.mainBranch: main - always deployable, merges via PR only
gitWorkflow.commitStyle: Conventional commits (feat:, fix:, test:, docs:, chore:). No AI/Claude attribution. No em dashes.

productMetrics: Active users (people who used the app)
Engagement (% of signups who actually use)

nextMilestones: Landing page with working email waitlist

engineering: Learn React hooks and state management
Learn to call external APIs safely
Full stack: frontend → API → database → external API
productManagement: Track metrics (users, engagement, not just features)

recruitingSignals.engineering: Full-stack depth, async patterns, security (RLS), external API integration
recruitingSignals.productManagement: User research, MVP thinking, metrics tracking, iteration
recruitingSignals.github: Clean commits, semantic PRs, main always works
